plugins.name: noibu
plugins.description: Built for ecommerce, the Noibu plugin bridges the gap between customer experience and revenue by connecting Claude directly to your store's session, error, and conversion data through Noibu — and to the marketing, support, and commerce platforms that put insight into motion. Go beyond analysis: surface what's costing you revenue, take action across your stack, build workflows to automate work end-to-end.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Manage tasks, plan your day, and build up memory of important context about your work. Syncs with your calendar, email, and chat to keep everything organized and on track.
